title: Keep task byte totals accurate when exporting after CRLF enrolment
outcome: Keep task byte totals accurate when exporting after CRLF enrolment
acceptance: After complete enrolment from a Git-clean CRLF checkout of LF blobs, editing a task, exporting and confirming the exact committed output records the total byte length of the committed task blobs. A regression exercises that complete export and confirmation sequence.
